title: Seed cloning
body: Public edition. Real-world reference information, fact-checked. Seed cloning copies a working database package (records, generator, page) to start a new database on a new topic. The clone keeps the proven structure and swaps in new content. Cloning is the fastest way to grow the network without reinventing packaging. The Signature edition of this database ties this entry to Signature hither thither able, the named Signature concept.
